title: cli: `os build` does not run the override-declaration judge that `os validate`, publish and install run
body:
domain:server#1 · os-project-manager · session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC

Filed from the contract review of PR #28554 (#28410, N-09 of #28236), note 1 of record `6556791212`. A follow-up, not a defect on `main`: nothing is admitted silently today.

## Reading

- #28410 wires one override-declaration rule (`judgeOverrideWrite`) into the save door, the promotion, `os validate` (`findOverrideDeclarationRefusals`) and the managed install.
- `os build` (`packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts`) does not call `findOverrideDeclarationRefusals`. The PR records that honestly as a `VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES` row.
- Cost today: an artifact that `os build` emits with a refused override declaration (or an undeclared same-named item) is refused later, at the managed install and the publish doors, by the same judge. It is a late refusal, never a false acceptance.

## Question for triage

Should `os build` run `findOverrideDeclarationRefusals` beside `checkDependencyRanges`, so that the refusal arrives at build time? The reviewer recommends A (wire it in a follow-up card). This adds a refusal point to `os build`, so under 「新增门禁默认否」 it needs triage's grade before code.

Refs: #28410, PR #28554, ADR-0146 D2/D6, #28390 ruling A.
